titulo.intro: You are the new Chief People Officer of a bank with 80 years of history, 30,000 people, legacy systems and digital banks closing in. You have from 2027 to 2030 to get the bank ready for the AI era.
titulo.dica: Every people decision moves the business — just not right away.

comum.escolha: Pick 1 of the 3 strategies for the year

ajuda.engajamento: How involved the team feels with the work and the bank, from 0 to 100. High engagement pulls revenue and NPS up; low engagement predicts resignations.
ajuda.turnover: Share of people who resign each year. Replacing someone costs 0.5 to 2 annual salaries.
ajuda.prontidao: How much of the skills the strategy demands the bank already has, from 0 to 100. It is your capacity to execute the plan.
ajuda.custoPessoal: Total payroll on the game's index. Rises with external hiring and contingent workers; falls with automation.
ajuda.receita: Bank revenue on the game's index. Responds to engagement, readiness and AI copilots — with a lag.
ajuda.eficiencia: People cost divided by revenue, in points. The lower it is, the more revenue per unit of payroll.
ajuda.nps: How much customers recommend the bank, from -100 to 100. Rises with an engaged, prepared front line.
ajuda.risco: Regulatory exposure of the AI models in use. With no governance and no evidence, the Audit sends the bill.

abordagens.build: Build — grow the people already here

etiquetas.rapidoDica: The main effect lands this very semester.
etiquetas.lentoDica: The main effect only lands 2 or 3 semesters from now.
etiquetas.caroDica: Weighs on the budget now or every semester.
etiquetas.arriscadoDica: It may turn out differently than forecast: it depends on outsiders or on an unsupervised model.

atendimentoIA.contexto: 6,000 people in customer service, no copilot in production. Customers already compare you to the digital challenger.
atendimentoIA.build: Reskill ~{n} service reps in their current roles, with an AI track applied to daily work.
atendimentoIA.buy: Hire ~{n} ready-made digital service specialists, paying the market premium.
atendimentoIA.borrow: Bring in ~{n} temps and freelancers to hold the volume while the team learns.
atendimentoIA.bot: License an AI copilot for {f} of the {tot} job families, starting with customer service.

dadosSaida.titulo: Data team walking out the door
dadosSaida.contexto: Fintechs are poaching your data engineers. Whoever leaves takes the pipeline knowledge along.
dadosSaida.build: Open ~{n} internal roles and data career tracks for people already in the bank.
dadosSaida.buy: Backfill with ~{n} market hires, at talent-war prices.
dadosSaida.borrow: Cover ~{n} positions with consultants and freelancers until the team stabilizes.

legadoCredito.titulo: Legacy credit system with no successor
legadoCredito.contexto: The credit engine runs on COBOL and only three people can touch it. Two retire in 2028.
legadoCredito.build: Reskill and redeploy ~{n} people into the credit core, mentored by the veterans.
legadoCredito.buy: Hire ~{n} legacy-modernization specialists from the market.
legadoCredito.bot: Automate the credit workflows that today take ~{n} people.

backoffice.titulo: Back office full of manual rework
backoffice.contexto: Reconciliations done by hand, spreadsheets everywhere, and an efficiency ratio the board asks about every quarter.
backoffice.build: Reskill and redeploy ~{n} back-office people into higher-value work.
backoffice.borrow: Cover the peak with ~{n} temps while the processes are redesigned.
backoffice.bot: Automate the routines that today consume ~{n} people.

squadIA.contexto: Every committee wants to 'do something with AI' and nobody inside the bank owns it.
squadIA.build: Train ~{n} people from the current team to staff the AI squad.
squadIA.buy: Hire ~{n} AI specialists on the market, at auction prices.
squadIA.borrow: Staff the squad with ~{n} freelancers and partners, with no long-term commitment.
squadIA.bot: Equip {f} of the {tot} job families with an AI copilot and learn by using it.

comercialDigital.titulo: Sales force with no digital repertoire
comercialDigital.contexto: The branch network sells like it's 2015. The customer arrives through the app and finds a paper process.
comercialDigital.build: Reskill ~{n} people in the sales network, in their current roles.
comercialDigital.bot: Give an AI copilot to {f} of the {tot} job families, starting with sales.

governancaModelos.contexto: Models are deciding credit with no documentation, no control group and nobody accountable for the explanation.
governancaModelos.build: Reskill and redeploy ~{n} risk and compliance people into model governance.
governancaModelos.buy: Hire ~{n} model-risk specialists from the market.
governancaModelos.borrow: Bring in ~{n} external auditors and consultants to set the governance up.

lideranca.contexto: Managers trained to monitor attendance now have to assess delivery — and nobody taught them how.
lideranca.build: Promote and develop ~{n} leaders from inside the bank.
lideranca.buy: Hire ~{n} leaders from outside, with a salary premium and a two-year ramp.
lideranca.bot: Give an AI copilot to {f} of the {tot} job families, supporting management and feedback.

sucessao.titulo: Succession wide open in critical roles
sucessao.contexto: Half of the critical positions have no successor mapped. The board will ask.
sucessao.build: Prepare ~{n} internal successors with career plans and mentoring.
sucessao.buy: Hire ~{n} ready people from outside for the critical positions.
sucessao.borrow: Cover the roles with ~{n} interim leaders and consultants while nothing gets decided.

politicas.hibridoAjuda: Formalizes 2 work-from-home days per week. Cuts resignations by about a third with no loss of performance (Bloom, Han & Liang, Nature 2024). Without clear goals, though, it turns into confusion and drags engagement down.
politicas.gpr: Hybrid + assess by delivery, not by hours
politicas.gprAjuda: The same hybrid setup, but with goals and outcome-based assessment instead of presence. It costs more to roll out and avoids the management confusion loose hybrid creates.
politicas.painelAjuda: Buys people data permanently: pulls indicators out of the fog more often and makes the semester forecast sharper. It also serves as evidence when the regulator asks.

t1.manchete: 2027 — The new strategic plan demands an AI-ready bank. The skills gap is the widest in decades.
t1.fala_ceo: I need results NOW. Hire ready-made people and let's go.
t1.fala_voz: If you only hire from outside, the people who've been here 20 years will get the message — and leave.

t2.manchete: 2028 — Digital banks slash fees. The board demands efficiency.
t2.fala_cfo: Automate everything you can. Training? Cut it. It's always the first thing out of the budget.
t2.fala_voz: Automating without reskilling is firing in slow motion. The team feels it.

t3.manchete: 2029 — BOSS: THE AI WAVE. A digital competitor launches 100% AI service. Our NPS starts to melt.
t3.fala_cto: I warned you! Scale the copilots NOW or we become a museum piece.
t3.fala_ceo: It's not about how, it's about when: yesterday.

t4.manchete: 2030 — Last year of the cycle. The board wants to see the Bank Value. What did you plant?
t4.fala_cfo: Harvest time. No new adventures in the final year.
t4.fala_cto: Adventures? The future doesn't wait for planning cycles.

t1a.descricao: Go to the market for the missing profiles, paying whatever premium it takes. Immediate capacity — and a payroll to match.

t1b.descricao: Reskill the current team and promote from within. Costs now, pays back in 2–3 years.

t1c.descricao: License AI copilots with training and bring in a few specialists. Productivity rises — most among novices.

t2a.descricao: Automate entire processes and freeze the training budget. Efficiency says thanks. The team... we'll see.

t2b.descricao: Automate with a reskilling program alongside. Pricier, less trauma.

t2c.descricao: Formalize hybrid work with clear goals and keep growing people from within. Those with flexibility stay.

t3a.descricao: Answer the wave with AI that augments the service team, training as you go.

t3b.descricao: Hire an AI squad from the market and reinforce with temps. Fast and expensive.

t3c.descricao: Don't react on impulse: invest only in data to decide better next year.

t4a.descricao: Consolidate copilots, promote those who reskilled and close the cycle with the team on board.

t4b.descricao: Automate what's left and double the copilots. Everything on the final table.

t4c.descricao: Invest heavily in reskilling and redeployment. The payoff may come after 2030.

t1.manchete: 2027/1 — You take over the People Office. The diagnosis: the widest skills gap in decades and a strategic plan that depends on closing it.
t1.fala: The team wants to believe. Show them we can grow from within before filling the bank with outsiders.

t2.manchete: 2027/2 — Digital banks cut fees and the board demands the efficiency ratio.
t2.fala: Every efficiency point is gold. Training is the first cut — always has been.

t3.manchete: 2028/1 — BOSS: THE AI WAVE. A digital competitor launches 100% AI service and our NPS starts to melt.
t3.fala: Either we scale AI now, or in two years we're the case study nobody wants to be.

t4.manchete: 2028/2 — Wave hangover: every committee wants to 'do something with AI'. Few know what.
t4.fala: Revenue. It's the only word I want to hear in this committee.

t5.manchete: 2029/1 — BOSS: THE TALENT RAIDER. A fintech offers your data team double the salary.
t5.fala: Money takes away those who already had one foot out the door. Career and purpose keep the rest.

t6.manchete: 2029/2 — Second-to-last year. The 2027 investments start to show up (or to be missed).
t6.fala: The board wants to see the curve going up. What you planted, you harvest now.

t7.manchete: 2030/1 — BOSS: THE AUDIT. The regulator demands governance of the AI models used in credit.
t7.fala: Fines and provisions I know how to calculate. Improvised governance, I don't.

t8.manchete: 2030/2 — Final semester. In December, the board assesses the Bank Value — and your legacy.
t8.fala: The future doesn't end in 2030. What stays standing after your tenure?

grupos.nota: Workforce planning: for each gap, decide between build (L&D), buy (hiring), borrow (flex) or bot (AI).

alavancas.contratarDica: Immediate capacity; costs ~20% more and leaves more
alavancas.internoDica: Cheaper and engaging; takes a semester
alavancas.ia_autoDica: Cuts cost; without L&D alongside, it hurts the team
alavancas.flexDica: Covers gaps now, at a price

inteligencia.descricao: People indicators are in the fog. Pay for data — or decide in the dark.
inteligencia.previsaoResultado: If nothing changes, turnover should land at ~{v}% a year.
inteligencia.piloto: Test the AI copilot in 1 branch
inteligencia.pilotoResultado: Pilot commissioned: the real result lands next semester, before you decide to scale.
inteligencia.pilotoFala: That is what the AI copilot did to the revenue of ONE branch, in one semester. Multiplying it by every branch is a bet — but now it is a bet with a number on it.

revelado.engajamento: Engagement is at {v} — the in-game market average is {media}.
revelado.turnover: Voluntary turnover is at {v}% a year — the in-game market average is {media}%.
revelado.prontidao: Skills readiness is at {v} — the in-game market average is {media}.

inteligencia.compromissos: Commitments from earlier semesters already took {v} of this semester's {base} coins.

decisao.subtitulo: Choose how to close each gap — then sign.
decisao.avisoCapacidade: More than {max} initiatives at once drags engagement down!
decisao.escolhaTamanho: How big should the package be?
decisao.custoUnico: One-off cost: comes out of this semester's budget.
decisao.custoRecorrente: Subscription: keeps weighing on the budget of the coming semesters.
decisao.compromissosDica: Sum of the recurring commitments already made. It comes out of the coming semesters' budgets automatically.
decisao.reguaTitulo: Where each choice lands its effect
decisao.reguaNota: ⚡ effect right this semester · 🌱 a seed: the main effect sprouts in the semester marked. Hover to see which choice is which.
decisao.previsaoCega: With no people analytics, you are deciding in the dark: buy data in the briefing to see the arrows.
decisao.previsaoDirecao: With the data you have, you can see the direction — but the uncertainty band is wide.
decisao.previsaoPrecisa: With the people analytics history you built up, the uncertainty band got narrow.

corte.texto: The CFO asks for a 20% cut in next semester's people budget. 'Everyone is cutting.'
corte.a: Accept the cut (2 fewer coins next semester; cost drops)
corte.b: Negotiate and keep it (the team notices the defense; cost stays a bit higher)

aposentadoria.texto: Three of the last specialists in the legacy credit system announce retirement at the end of the semester.
aposentadoria.a: Retention package + mentoring (expensive, the knowledge stays)
aposentadoria.b: Let them go and trust the documentation (spoiler: it doesn't exist)

voltaEscritorio.texto: A board member read an article about 'the end of home office' and wants everyone back 5 days a week.

pilotoIA.texto: An AI pilot in customer service did well in ONE branch. Every committee wants to scale it nationally — without a control group.
pilotoIA.a: Scale now (quick revenue, unmeasured model risk)
pilotoIA.b: Measure before scaling (costs 1 coin, becomes evidence)

porqueEvento.corte.a: You accepted the CFO's cut: lower cost, smaller budget.
porqueEvento.corte.b: You defended the people budget: the team noticed.
porqueEvento.aposentadoria.a: The retention package kept the legacy knowledge in-house.
porqueEvento.aposentadoria.b: The specialists left — and the legacy knowledge with them.
porqueEvento.voltaEscritorio.b: Forced return to the office: engagement and retention felt it.
porqueEvento.pilotoIA.a: Scaling without measuring: the revenue came, so did the risk.
porqueEvento.pilotoIA.b: You measured before scaling: evidence in your pocket.

nevoa.motivo0: The Risk team could not release this semester's data.
nevoa.motivo1: The engagement survey slipped: the field only closes at the end of the semester.
nevoa.motivo2: The HR system migration left the database inconsistent this period.
nevoa.motivo3: The report exists, but it is stuck in the Audit approval queue.

feedback.previaTitulo: This — and only this — will be sent:
feedback.previaAviso: No name, e-mail or personal data. Opens a form in a new tab; nothing is sent unless you click Submit there.

debrief2.eSeExplica: Redo one of these decisions with a balanced allocation and see the alternative outcome.
debrief2.eSeResultado: With that swap, the Bank Value in 2030 would be {v} (it was {v0}).
debrief2.insightEnganosoItem: In semester {t}, the data shown ({campo}: {mostrado}) was distorted; the real value was {real}. Correlation isn't causation — and dashboards get it wrong.

pesquisa.nber: AI copilot: +14% productivity (+34% among novices) and higher retention — Brynjolfsson, Li & Raymond (NBER)
pesquisa.bidwell: External hires: ~+20% salary, worse reviews for 2 years, leave more — Bidwell (Wharton)
pesquisa.bloom: Hybrid (2 days at home): -1/3 attrition, equal performance — Bloom, Han & Liang (Nature 2024)
pesquisa.wef: 39% of skills change by 2030; 59 in every 100 people need training — WEF Future of Jobs 2025
pesquisa.gallupQ12: Top-quartile engagement: +23% profitability, +18% sales productivity (correlation) — Gallup Q12
pesquisa.gallupCusto: Replacing a person costs 0.5 to 2 annual salaries — Gallup

porque.capacidade.excesso: Too many initiatives at once: the organization couldn't absorb them and engagement fell.
porque.contratar.imediato: External hires brought immediate capacity (performing below potential in the first 2 years — Bidwell/Wharton).
porque.contratar.rampa: The external hires reached full performance (Bidwell/Wharton).
porque.contratar.turnoverExterno: External hires leave more in the first years (Bidwell/Wharton).
porque.contratar.turnoverExternoFim: The extra attrition from external hires has passed.
porque.interno.prontidao: Internal moves covered gaps with people who already know the bank.
porque.interno.engajamento: Internal promotions signal career paths: engagement rose.
porque.ld.cargo: Reskilling in role lifted readiness (WEF: 29 in 100 need it).
porque.ld.horasTreinamento: Hours in training reduced output this period.
porque.ld.decaimento: Without L&D investment, skills go stale and readiness drops.
porque.ia.autoEngajamento: Automating without reskilling scared the team: engagement falling.
porque.ia.autoTurnover: Fear of being replaced by AI: more people resigning.
porque.ia.autoPerdaConhecimento: Tacit knowledge walked out the door with the people.
porque.ia.copilotoProdutividade: AI copilots lifted productivity (+14% on average, +34% among novices — NBER w31161).
porque.ia.copilotoRetencao: Tools that help (instead of threaten) increased retention (NBER w31161).
porque.hibrido.turnover: Hybrid cut attrition by about a third (Bloom et al., Nature 2024).
porque.hibrido.semGPR: Hybrid without results-based management: confusion and falling engagement.
porque.flex.prontidao: Temps and partners covered gaps in the short term.
porque.flex.custo: The flexible workforce has its price.
porque.flex.fimContrato: The temporary contracts ended and took the capacity with them: borrowing covers the gap, it does not build the skill.
porque.pressao.receita: Digital banks keep biting into revenue.
porque.pressao.nps: The customer bar rises every year; stand still and NPS falls.
porque.encadeamento.engajamentoReceita: More engaged teams sold more (Gallup: +18% productivity correlation).
porque.encadeamento.engajamentoNps: Engaged people serve better: NPS responded (Gallup).
porque.encadeamento.prontidaoReceita: Ready skills became capacity to execute the strategy.
porque.encadeamento.custoReposicao: Replacing leavers costs 0.5 to 2 annual salaries (Gallup).
porque.encadeamento.perdaConhecimento: Turnover too high: knowledge is evaporating.
porque.divida.jurosReceita: People debt is charging interest on revenue.
porque.divida.jurosTurnover: People debt is charging interest on turnover.
porque.chefao.ondaIA.mitigado: You had AI in production: the wave only grazed the NPS.
porque.chefao.ondaIA.nps: With no AI answer, customers migrated: NPS plunged.
porque.chefao.ondaIA.receita: The AI wave took revenue with it.
porque.chefao.cacaTalentos.mitigado: Your team had reasons to stay: the raider took little.
porque.chefao.cacaTalentos.prontidao: The fintech took your best data specialists.
porque.chefao.cacaTalentos.turnover: The fintech's poaching spread to other departures.
porque.chefao.auditoria.receita: The regulator restricted ungoverned credit models.
porque.chefao.auditoria.custo: Scrambling for governance at the last minute was expensive.

arquiteto.texto: You balanced short and long term: people ready, business healthy. The bank reaches 2030 ready for the AI era.

bombeiro.texto: You put out every quarterly fire — and reached 2030 out of breath. Quick results, fragile foundation.

jardineiro.texto: You grew an amazing team... and the business wilted waiting for the harvest. People strategy is business strategy — in both directions.

apostador.texto: All-in on AI, with no data and no people ready. Costs fell fast; the bill came later, with interest.

debrief.pergunta: To take back to work: which people decision in your area is being judged only by its short-term effect?
debrief.desbloqueio: Traditional Mode unlocked! 8 semesters, free budget, fog of war and 3 bosses.
